plain: TextProps is now a union type, so write `type X = TextProps & { … }` instead of `interface X extends TextProps`.

steps.plain: An `interface X extends TextProps` no longer compiles because TextProps is a union (truncate and lineClamp exclude each other): write `type X = TextProps & { … }`.
A wrapper that spreads an `Omit<TextProps, …>` into Text can fail to compile: keep `truncate` and `lineClamp` out of the Omit, or cast the spread to `TextProps`.
